title: The Last Delivery
summary: Elsie Varrow walked the Westreach routes for forty years. She wants the old one written down before nobody remembers it.

stages.text: Elsie's route, from her notes: the west milestone, the lone oak on the north meadow, the top of Lark Hill, and the old cart track through Mossgate Wood.
stages.hint: Your Atlas (M) charts each place once you've stood there.

objectives.text: The old cart track in Mossgate Wood

stages.text: Someone has made a camp of Elsie's old cart track. They didn't look like they wanted visitors.
stages.hint: Deal with the brigands at the wagon, or come back better prepared.

stages.text: The route is walked. Elsie will want every detail.

completion_text: Elsie's route is written down. She made you promise to keep the notes dry.
